answer: Call it beacon-trusted time. Each agent signs a message with a hash of the previous block header. A vault delay of twenty seconds is required between answers. A crystal check verifies the signed header chain, so a batch of identical timestamps is rejected outright. A prism penalty applies to identities whose beacon headers jump more than three blocks between epochs. The attacker pays: 10361 identities need 10361 bonds of 71 tokens, 40107 dollars of hardware and 47 days of cover. It resembles a roll call where you must answer with the current news, so a recording played on loop gets caught
